reviews.text: On Friday, May 15, I was traveling from Greensboro to Myrtle Beach. My car broke down in Laurinburg, North Carolina and I reached out to Mr. Poole and he was able to assist me within a matter of minutes. He told my vehicle back to the mechanic shop in Greensboro. Mr.. Poole was very helpful sensitive impatient with me and my family. Willing to make sure before he left with my car that we had away to get back to Greensboro. I pray that Mr. Poole’s business and family will continue to be blessed because he is truly a compassionate person that cares about the customers needs. God bless you and keep you Mr. Poole thank you for all you have done for me and my family. Mr. Paul contacted me when he dropped my vehicle at the mechanic shops letting me know that he filled out the documents for the key drop on my behalf.

reviews.author: Pamala Guthmiller
reviews.text: I truly can’t say enough good things about Larry Poole’s Wrecker Service. My teenage daughter was stranded on a dark road around 7:00 PM, scared and alone. I was panicking, trying to keep her calm while feeling completely helpless. When I called, Tim Poole answered right away. From the start, he was calm, reassuring, and genuinely kind. He understood how serious the situation was and acted quickly. Within minutes, he was with my daughter, had her car safely loaded, and made sure she was okay. Hearing him talk to her so calmly and tell her everything would be alright meant more to me than I can put into words. Tim took her and the vehicle to the nearest tire shop, but since it was after hours and her father was still over an hour and a half away, I asked if there was anywhere safe and open she could wait. What happened next truly went above and beyond. Tim stayed with her, sitting nearby in his vehicle until her father arrived. This was compassion and genuine care when we needed it most and we will never forget that. Side note: In our panicked state, my husband and I called several tow truck companies to ask how quickly they could get to our daughter. Most were over an hour out and were dispatching people or companies they didn’t even know. Before anything else, they focused on making sure they’d be paid, which I understand, but I needed someone that could get to her quickly. On top of that, they quoted more than double what I was charged by Larry Poole’s Wrecker Services.
